claim_summary: The closure of reciprocal-cubic divisor sums over squarefree integers is the disjoint union of sixteen intervals indexed by subsets of the primes 2,3,5,7; their common tail factor is the Euler product over primes at least 11.
integrity: The mathematical argument and exact-rational reproduction steps are presented in full. No independent audit or absolute historical priority is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only squarefree positive integers and divisor exponent three.
The exact-component result does not apply to unrestricted inputs.
The proof invokes the published Nagura prime-interval theorem.
Possible equivalent unindexed earlier work has not been excluded.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Sixteen components of the reciprocal-cubic divisor range on squarefree integers
